Band Pull-Apart.how: Hold band at shoulder height; pull hands apart until arms align with torso; return slowly.
Band Pull-Apart.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Band External Rotation.how: Elbow bent ~90° near side; rotate forearm outward against light band; return slowly.
Band External Rotation.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Scapular Push-Up.how: In plank, keep elbows straight; let shoulder blades come together, then push floor away.
Scapular Push-Up.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

T-Spine Rotation.how: Rotate through upper back while hips stay quiet; follow hand with eyes.
T-Spine Rotation.cue: Rotate upper back, not low back.
T-Spine Rotation.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Medicine-Ball Chest Throw.how: Brace and throw ball straight forward from chest with maximum acceleration; reset each rep.
Medicine-Ball Chest Throw.cue: Reset every rep; stop if speed drops.
Medicine-Ball Chest Throw.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Medicine-Ball Overhead Throw/Slam.how: Brace, raise ball overhead, then throw/slam explosively without overextending low back.
Medicine-Ball Overhead Throw/Slam.cue: Use a ball light enough to accelerate.
Medicine-Ball Overhead Throw/Slam.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Incline Barbell Press.how: Set bench 20–35°; shoulder blades back/down; lower to upper chest; press up and slightly back.
Incline Barbell Press.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Weighted Pull-Up / Heavy Pulldown.how: From controlled stretch, drive elbows down toward ribs; lower under control.
Weighted Pull-Up / Heavy Pulldown.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Machine Chest Press.how: Seat handles at mid-chest; brace; press nearly straight; lower slowly to comfortable stretch.
Machine Chest Press.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Chest-Supported Row.how: Keep chest on pad; pull elbows toward lower ribs; squeeze and lower fully.
Chest-Supported Row.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Cable Fly.how: With slight fixed elbow bend, bring arms together in a wide hugging arc; return to comfortable stretch.
Cable Fly.cue: Wide hugging arc; fixed elbow bend.
Cable Fly.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Pullover.how: Keep ribs down; move arms from overhead toward torso using lats; return slowly.
Pullover.cue: Ribs down; drive upper arms down.
Pullover.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Heavy Farmer Carry.how: Pick up with strong hinge; stand tall and walk controlled with weights at sides.
Heavy Farmer Carry.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Bike / Rower / Incline Walk.how: Maintain sustainable conversational Zone 2 pace with smooth mechanics.
Bike / Rower / Incline Walk.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Hip Mobility.how: Use controlled hip ranges appropriate to athlete; avoid forcing end range.
Hip Mobility.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

T-Spine / Shoulder Mobility.how: Move upper back and shoulders through comfortable controlled ranges; do not fatigue.
T-Spine / Shoulder Mobility.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

90/90 Hip Rotation.how: Sit with knees bent ~90° and rotate knees side-to-side under control.
90/90 Hip Rotation.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Adductor Rock-Back.how: From quadruped with one leg extended sideways, rock hips back with neutral spine.
Adductor Rock-Back.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Walking Lunge + Rotation.how: Step into controlled lunge; stabilize, rotate torso toward front leg, return and step through.
Walking Lunge + Rotation.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Glute Bridge.how: Feet planted; brace; squeeze glutes to lift hips; pause and lower without arching low back.
Glute Bridge.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Pogo / Ankling Prep.how: Perform small quick ankle-dominant hops with minimal knee bend and quiet contacts.
Pogo / Ankling Prep.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Countermovement Jump / Box Jump.how: Dip quickly, jump with max intent, land softly and stabilize; fully reset.
Countermovement Jump / Box Jump.avoid: Excessive box height, valgus landing, fatigue reps.

Medicine-Ball Rotational Scoop Throw.how: Load rear hip and rotate explosively to throw ball into wall; reset.
Medicine-Ball Rotational Scoop Throw.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Back Squat / Safety-Bar Squat.how: Brace, descend between hips/knees with whole foot down; drive up maintaining knee/torso position.
Back Squat / Safety-Bar Squat.avoid: Loss of brace, knee collapse, grinding beyond RIR.

Romanian Deadlift.how: Soft knees; push hips back with weight close to legs; stop at strong hamstring tension; stand tall.
Romanian Deadlift.avoid: Rounding back, squatting the hinge, reaching for floor.

Leg Press.how: Keep pelvis on pad; lower sled to controlled depth; press through whole foot.
Leg Press.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat.how: Rear foot elevated; lower rear knee while front leg controls; drive through front foot.
Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Seated / Lying Leg Curl.how: Align knee with machine pivot; curl heel toward glute; squeeze and return slowly.
Seated / Lying Leg Curl.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Standing Calf Raise.how: Lower heel to comfortable stretch; rise through forefoot; pause; lower without bouncing.
Standing Calf Raise.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Heavy Sled Push.how: Brace into handles and drive ground backward with short powerful steps.
Heavy Sled Push.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Suitcase Carry.how: Carry one heavy weight at side while resisting any lateral lean.
Suitcase Carry.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Band Shoulder Series.how: Use light-band pull-aparts/external rotations/overhead patterns as preparation, not fatigue.
Band Shoulder Series.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Face Pull.how: Pull rope toward face while separating ends; finish hands near temples.
Face Pull.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Scapular Wall Slide.how: Ribs down; slide forearms upward while shoulder blades rotate naturally.
Scapular Wall Slide.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Medicine-Ball Overhead Throw.how: Brace and throw ball explosively from overhead; reset completely.
Medicine-Ball Overhead Throw.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Explosive Cable Row.how: Use moderate load; row fast toward ribs, then return under control.
Explosive Cable Row.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Seated DB Shoulder Press.how: Sit supported; brace; press dumbbells overhead; lower to comfortable depth.
Seated DB Shoulder Press.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Weighted Chin-Up.how: From controlled hang, drive elbows down until chin clears bar; lower without kipping.
Weighted Chin-Up.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Machine / DB Lateral Raise.how: Raise upper arms to roughly shoulder height with soft elbows; lower slowly.
Machine / DB Lateral Raise.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Rear-Delt Fly.how: Chest supported if possible; open arms wide with soft elbows; return under control.
Rear-Delt Fly.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

EZ-Bar Curl.how: Keep upper arms near torso; curl without hip drive; lower under control.
EZ-Bar Curl.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Incline DB Curl.how: Arms hang from incline bench; curl without upper-arm swing; control full stretch.
Incline DB Curl.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Cable Pressdown.how: Elbows pinned; extend arms fully; squeeze triceps; return under control.
Cable Pressdown.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Overhead Cable Extension.how: Upper arms overhead; bend and extend elbows while trunk remains braced.
Overhead Cable Extension.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Dynamic Athletic Warm-Up.how: Progress through dynamic mobility and movement drills, gradually increasing speed/range.
Dynamic Athletic Warm-Up.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Medicine-Ball Rotational Throw.how: Load hips, rotate from ground up and throw into wall with maximum speed.
Medicine-Ball Rotational Throw.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Battle-Rope Power Slam.how: Raise ropes and drive them forcefully into floor while maintaining braced athletic posture.
Battle-Rope Power Slam.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Kettlebell Swing.how: Hike bell into hinge; snap hips to propel it; guide it back into next hinge.
Kettlebell Swing.avoid: Squatting the swing, arm lifting, lumbar hyperextension.

Farmer Carry.how: Carry heavy implements at sides with tall posture, stable trunk and controlled steps.
Farmer Carry.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Sled Push.how: Lean into sled and drive with rhythmic powerful steps while maintaining constant pressure.
Sled Push.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Backward Sled Drag.how: Face sled and walk backward with smooth controlled steps and tall torso.
Backward Sled Drag.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Push-Up.how: Rigid head-to-heel line; lower chest under control; press floor away.
Push-Up.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

TRX / Inverted Row.how: Keep body rigid; pull chest toward handles/bar; lower under control.
TRX / Inverted Row.cue: Rigid body; pull chest to handles.
TRX / Inverted Row.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.

Assault Bike / Rower.how: Alternate hard repeatable work with prescribed recovery; avoid blowing up on first interval.
Assault Bike / Rower.avoid: Momentum, forced range, or technique breakdown.
